lethal_cure.label: Lethal poison with a cure in reach (the recorded shape)
lethal_cure.explanation: 7 HP, a 40-turn poison timer, Recall pending (word_recall 20), one Cure Critical Wounds potion, a quiet square. The original rests for Recall ('R 500') - a poison tick every turn, dead before lift-off. The corrected borg weighs the pending poison (one damage point per world turn, timer lowered by adj_con_fix(CON)+1, lift-off after word_recall turns) and spends the turn curing ('q') instead.

lethal_no_cure.label: Lethal poison with no cure at all
lethal_no_cure.explanation: The same lethal state with nothing that cures. The original still rests into the poison; the corrected borg does not rest - no cure to quaff, so the regular flows keep it moving instead of waiting for the poison to kill it.
